module: Flowgraph node "Track Prefab" (once_instant). Lets the flowgraph track a prefab created outside the flowgraph, via modules.prefab:addPrefab(id, options). Inputs: flow, id (0 = player's prefab according to the description), dontDelete, skipNavgraphReload, skipCollisionReload (all true by default, hidden).
notes: The icon references nodeIcons.svene (typo): nil icon.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.
